newsitem.title: USA: Johnstown says wins ruling against Trinity.
newsitem.headline: Johnstown says wins ruling against Trinity.

text.p: Johnstown America Industries Inc said Monday a federl appeals court ruled in its favor in a patent infringement lawsuit against Trinity Industries Inc.
Johnstown said the court ruled that Trinity's Aluminator II coal gondola freight car infringed Johnstown's patent. The ruling reversed a 1996 district court judgment.
The appeals court remanded the case to the district court for determination of damages and for consideration of Johnstown's claim that Trinity's alleged infringement was willful, Johnstown said.
Johnstown said it could not predict the damages it might be awarded.

Following the appeals court ruling, Johnston said it had filed a motion in U.S. District Court for the Western District of Pennsylvania, in Pittsburgh, for a permanent injunction to prohibit Trinity from making, selling or offering to sell its Aluminator II coal gondola freight car until Johnstown's patent expires in November 1999.
Johnstown said its Johnstown America Corp subsidiary brought the suit against Trinity in 1992.
